description: Flood Depth Comparison (1% AEP) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Use this app to compare the 1% AEP food depth in our updated mapping (released Feb 2025) as compared to the previous available mapping (dated 2014-2016) The Moreton Bay Region includes different landscapes and terrain which may be impacted by different types of flooding. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are __. It offers 2 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, html. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
